name: aalaapi-sky
description: Aalaapi-Sky Drone Flight Planner & Editor for DJI Fly

scripts.bridge:stop: node -e "require('http').request({hostname:'127.0.0.1',port:process.env.AALAAPI_PORT||8765,path:'/api/shutdown',method:'POST'},res=>{console.log('Aalaapi Sky Bridge stopped.');process.exit(0);}).on('error',()=>console.log('Aalaapi Sky Bridge is not running.')).end()"
scripts.companion:stop: node -e "require('http').request({hostname:'127.0.0.1',port:process.env.AALAAPI_PORT||8765,path:'/api/shutdown',method:'POST'},res=>{console.log('Aalaapi Sky Companion stopped.');process.exit(0);}).on('error',()=>console.log('Aalaapi Sky Companion is not running.')).end()"
